hooks.command: if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git pull --ff-only >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; true

if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git add -A; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m "WIP: auto-sync $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git push >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; fi; true
hooks.commandWindows: if ((git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree) 2>$null) { git add -A; git diff --cached --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git commit -m "WIP: auto-sync $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')" *> $null; git push *> $null } }
